text:
sam.carver: Ok team — scheduling Spectral Edge Dedicated switchover for the private tenant. Change window: Apr 10 02:00-03:00 UTC. Planned model/service changes: pin tenant to runtime v3.3.0, rollout via canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%). Rollback target: revert to v3.2.1 if health checks breach thresholds. Please ACK if you’re on call and this window works.

deploy-bot: [deploy-queue] queued dedicated/spectral-edge:target=v3.3.0 canary=10% scheduled at 02:00 UTC by sam.carver. Runbook ID: rb/spectral-2026-04-10-02.
maria-ng: Quick Q — are we also pinning model weights or just runtime?
ops_jordan: We’re pinning runtime + model snapshot. Model snapshot tag: spectral-2026-03-29. Fallback snapshot: spectral-2026-02-14 (v3.2.1).
nate.builds: Canary config snippet: ```json
{
  "canary": [10,50,100],
  "health_checks": {"error_rate_pct": 1.0, "p95_latency_ms": 250},
  "smoke_checks": ["/v1/health","/v1/generate?prompt=smoke"],
  "rollback_action": "auto_or_manual"
}
```
product-elena: Customer communications: Support already sent a pre-window note yesterday. I messaged the key contacts — they asked for a 30m hold if anything looks off.
security-bot: KMS rotation check: OK. No outstanding secrets flagged for that tenant. Audit token present.
sam.carver: Monitoring plan — Ops will watch first 30m closely, SRE will have tracing open. Logging retention for this run: 14d. Links: https://observability.internal/streams/spectral-edge (use internal VPN).
ops_jordan: On-call coverage confirmed: @ops_jordan (primary), @maria-ng (backup). Rollback criteria I’ll use: >1% sustained error rate for 5m OR p95 >250ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows. I’ll call a manual rollback if external errors spike even below those thresholds.
sam.carver: Approvals needed from product/security/devex — @product-elena @maria-ng please ACK.
maria-ng: ACK :thumbsup: good to go from infra side.
product-elena: ACK. Customer notified and on standby.
nate.builds: Canary started at 02:00 UTC — initial 10% slice. Kicking off smoke tests now.
deploy-bot: [deploy-event] canary=10% started for dedicated/spectral-edge at 02:01 UTC. smoke=running.
nate.builds: 10m smoke pass: all endpoints OK, sample generations match expected token distribution. Increasing to 50%.
deploy-bot: [deploy-event] canary increased to 50% at 02:12 UTC.
sam.carver: Observability note — watch tokenization errors and reranking latencies. If we see >0.5% generation anomalies notify customer; Ops will decide rollback.
ops_jordan: Noted. Thresholds in alerting: error_rate >0.5% -> pager, >1% -> auto-escalate. I’m on standby.
deploy-bot: [deploy-event] canary advanced to 100% at 02:42 UTC. Cutover completed. No immediate critical errors.
product-elena: Customer reports smoke ok and initial integration tests passing.
security-bot: Audit log archived to s3://redwood-audit/spectral-edge/2026-04-10/1976543210.log.
sam.carver: Good work. Marking rollout as SUCCESS for Spectral Edge. Release note tag: v3.3.0-spectral-edge. I’ll follow up with a short postmortem if we see any regressions.
ops_jordan: I kept an eye on rates — small spike at 02:09 but under thresholds. No rollback needed. Closing oncall.
product-elena: Adding final notes to the customer ticket and including rollback instructions in the ticket.
sam.carver: Thanks team. If anyone sees delayed errors, reopen thread.
